So hello Ingressers, shapers, enlightenhumans and resistancehumans. Today ill tell u some tips! So lets get started!

1st: Do not attack portals when u see that you will not beat them!

Why?: First bad thing about this is, that you will lose your XMPs or Ultra Strikes. If you destroy some resonators then its not complete waste, but if u do not destroy anything then its complete waste of ur XM tank, power cubes and weapons.

Second bad thing is that notification will be sent to the owner/owners of portal and there is 75% chance that they are gonna recharge portal so you are gonna have to attack it again from checkpoint 0!

What to do right?: Keep eye on the portal you want to destroy. In citys with more than 30 portals where one faction has over 75% influence, most likelly enemy faction will forget about the portal u want to destroy. Once the energy is very low just attack. There are simulators for android and online simulators who allow you to calculate how much XMPs you will need to destroy a portal!

**Simulator: ** http://ipas.graphracer.com/

2. Keep eye on Ingress Intel!

 WebSite: intel.ingress.com

Why?: First reason is that you will be able to plan where to go and when to go. Without using it, its very hard to understand the current situation in your nearby area, or city!

Things you should be looking for in intel!:

1. Unmodded portals. Unmodded portal are very very easy to take down. Just click on one of the portals and find one who is unmodded. Then plan when you will go to it, then go and destroy it!

2. Ghost/Neutral Portals. Look for unclaimed portals. You have to zoom close in order to see them because they are displayed only on close zoom. If u do not see any portal that used to be somewhere, its either unlinked or its unclaimed. Also zoom close to random locations and you may be lucky to find one. Then go to there and claim your portal and get your sweet AP!

3. Weak, heavily upgraded portals. Try to look for portals who have resonators, who are on very low energy, but have for example all resonators Level 8, or they have very strong mods, or they are hubs (Portals with alot of links incoming or/and outgoing). Go and shoot some XMPs on them untill they turn gray. Those portals take up alot of team work, and resources from the opposition team, and they are gonna need to rebuild it again.

3. Do frequent attacks. Attack every portal that is posibble to destroy. This method will weaken opposition's stability of the region. Building up very well upgraded portals takes time, teamwork and resources. If you will frequently attack opposition they are gonna need to plan everything from new, and link, mod, claim everything from new. Do not give up as this will also increase your level. More unstable opposition's systems mean easier future war.

**4**. Look for portals who havent been submitted yet. You can submit portal from my own experience if it is:

Poster Tower (A thing that has posters about events and other stuff)

Memorial stones/plates.

Statues.

Buildings with interesting/advanced architecture.

Old, ruins of castles/storages and stuff from earlier centurys.

Memorials and statues inside graveyards.

Location maps, and maps who show cultural spots in your city.

Sport schools.

Culture centers.

Sport halls and normal halls!

Normal schools. WARNING! Primary and Secondary schools are not accepted. High schools, universitys, colleges, and gymnasiums are fine i guess!

So that's it for now! I hope you liked my tutorial!
